item.title: Owaisi urges 'Muslims voters' to build own leadership, takes aim at SP and Congress
item.description: In a passionate speech to voters in Azamgarh, Asaduddin Owaisi called on minority communities to pursue political autonomy and take charge of their own representation. He criticized the loyalty to long-established parties like Congress and SP, arguing they have failed to advocate for minority rights. Owaisi also examined the historical connections between Nehru and minority leaders, questioning whether current parties genuinely empower these groups.

item.title: 'Next PM Vijay 2029’: Placards trigger brief stir at PM Modi event in Chennai
item.description: During a government event in Chennai, PM Modi and CM Vijay inaugurated significant projects worth approximately Rs 13,000 crore. The gathering was briefly disrupted when supporters displayed placards promoting Vijay as the next Prime Minister. PM Modi emphasized the importance of cooperative federalism and vowed to continue supporting Tamil Nadu's development. Vijay called for the release of central funds and sought approval for additional infrastructure projects.
item.dc:creator: Yashasvi Vasistha

item.title: Less-than-2-lane NH stretches shrink to 8% as high-speed corridors surge
item.description: India's national highway system has undergone remarkable enhancements, reducing two-lane stretches to only 8%. In the past nine years, high-speed corridors have expanded over twelve times. Officials note that newer expressways allow trucks to travel significantly faster than traditional highways. Plans include constructing about 51,000 kilometers of access-controlled corridors in the next ten years, aiming to boost transport efficiency and cut logistics expenses across the nation.
item.dc:creator: Dipak K Dash

item.title: Tanker with 11 Indians on board attacked in Oman, 2 crew members missing
item.description: The tanker MT PETRO DOLPHIN faced an assault while anchored off the coast of Sohar, Oman, with 11 Indian crew aboard. While nine crew members were successfully rescued, two remain unaccounted for. Local Coast Guard authorities have mobilized search-and-rescue operations, with ongoing efforts to find the missing crew members. Minister Sarbananda Sonowal has pledged full support for the rescue efforts underway.
item.dc:creator: Trisha Mahajan

item.title: 'Can't intimidate democracy': CPM MP John Brittas writes to CJI, President & RS chair over Delhi police 'assault'
item.description: During a media interaction, CPI(M) Rajya Sabha MP John Brittas detailed an incident where he was allegedly assaulted by the Delhi Police while protesting for the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. He has demanded an independent investigation into the matter, highlighting serious breaches of constitutional rights. This incident has triggered widespread protests in the national capital, leading to over 200 detentions as citizens rally against the Election Commission.

item.title: Fuel tank cavities & Myanmar links: NCB busts 50 crores Yaba Haul, 2 Manipur residents arrested
item.description: The breakthrough comes as part of a wider, intensified crackdown on narcotics trafficking across the North Eastern region. Acting on intelligence inputs, NCB smeuths intercepted two suspicious trucks in Guwahati. A search of the vehicles uncovered specially fabricated concealed cavities cleverly built inside the fuel tanks -- a sophisticated method designed to evade law enforcement checkpoints. Officers recovered the massive consignment of methamphetamine on the spot. Both arrested suspects are residents of Bishnupur, Manipur.
item.dc:creator: Raj Shekhar Jha

item.title: IndiGo Delhi-Chennai flight diverts to Hyderabad after electronic device battery catches fire
item.description: An IndiGo flight from Delhi to Chennai experienced a diversion to Hyderabad following a fire incident. The fire was caused by a battery in a passenger's personal electronic device, which emitted smoke. Crew members promptly extinguished the fire and ensured passenger safety during the diversion. An alternate aircraft was arranged to continue the journey to Chennai after the incident.

item.title: ‘People want change’: Sachin Pilot says Congress will return to power in Punjab with absolute majority
item.description: Sachin Pilot expressed confidence in Congress regaining power in Punjab with an absolute majority in upcoming elections. He emphasized the loss of public faith in the Aam Aadmi Party government and the desire for change. Newly appointed Punjab Congress president Pargat Singh called for collective action to address the state's challenges. Former chief minister Charanjit Singh Channi highlighted issues such as corruption and drug abuse under the AAP administration.

item.title: CJP protest against CEC Gyanesh Kumar blocked in Goa, dozens detained
item.description: On Sunday, several protesters were detained by Goa Police during a demonstration targeting chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Noteworthy individuals, including Ferdin Rebello, the former chief justice of Allahabad high court, were not allowed to enter the protest area. Instead, demonstrators gathered outside the Goa Police headquarters, demanding Gyanesh Kumar's resignation due to alleged electoral roll irregularities, raising alarms about citizens' rights to peaceful assembly.
item.dc:creator: Mahima Sharma

item.title: 'Cops wanted to torment my parents at 3.30 am': Dipke's rebuttal to Delhi Police's clip
item.description: In a statement reacting to the police's account, Dipke said he had repeatedly requested access to his phone to retrieve his cousin's number and speak to a lawyer, but was denied both requests. He also questioned why officers asked him to call his father at 3.30 am and tell him that he could be sent to jail for a long time.

item.title: Evening news wrap: Police release Dipke's detention video; PM Modi pledges support to Tamil Nadu & more
item.description: Delhi Police released a video showing Abhijeet Dipke being informed of his grandmother's passing during detention. Prime Minister Modi pledged ongoing support for Tamil Nadu's infrastructure projects worth Rs 13,000 crore. An IndiGo flight from Delhi to Chennai made an emergency landing in Hyderabad after smoke was detected from a passenger's power bank. A scuffle erupted at the UP Congress office ahead of Aradhana Mishra's takeover as state president.
item.dc:creator: Yashasvi Vasistha

item.title: Delhi cops release video when they told Dipke in detention of grandmother’s death - watch
item.description: Delhi Police released a video showing officers informing Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke about his grandmother’s death in detention and offering help with travel arrangements for her last rites, which he declined. The release followed his mother’s allegation that police had failed to inform him. Dipke was detained ahead of a proposed protest demanding Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation and later released on an undertaking to maintain public order.
item.dc:creator: Vivek Dubey

item.title: ‘Competition of anarchy’: BJP hits out at Rahul Gandhi, Arvind Kejriwal amid CEC protest row
item.description: BJP MP Bansuri Swaraj condemned Congress leader Rahul Gandhi and Aam Aadmi Party leader Arvind Kejriwal for losing their voter base. She accused both parties of seeking excuses for their electoral defeats instead of constructive politics. Rahul Gandhi announced upcoming protests to challenge the government's actions against demonstrators. Kejriwal criticized PM Modi for police actions during protests and invoked historical comparisons.
item.dc:creator: Yashasvi Vasistha
